jobs.title: Additional Director (Ops & Vig) BPS-19
jobs.description:
Educational Qualification:
Master’s Degree M.Sc. (minimum 3.30 CGPA) in the field of development studies, public policy or sociology, with majors in international economics policy, microeconomics, food system and rural development, environmental economics, globalization, or a relevant field from an HEC-recognized university; and
Bachelor’s Degree (Graduation) from a recognized institution in Botany (plant anatomy, cellular genetics and physiology), Chemistry (organic, inorganic and applied chemistry).
All degrees must be from a university recognized by HEC.
Experience Requirements:
Minimum five years of overall cumulative professional experience in the Government, Semi-Government, or Private Sector or Educational Consultancy.
Specific experience in cannabis policy and cannabis licensing rules and regulations formulation/drafting, regulatory framework development, strategic planning/institutional development related to cannabis and hemp is mandatory.
Experience of Operations and Enforcement in the declared hard/remote areas in the government sector is also mandatory due to the nature of the tasks.
In case of higher qualification, experience may be curtailed up to two years.

jobs.title: Assistant Director
jobs.description:
Educational Qualification:
16-year or BS university degree (minimum 2nd Division) in Criminology, Public Administration, Public Policy, Law, Political Science, Natural Sciences, Chemistry, Economics, Artificial Intelligence, Management Sciences, Business Administration/Studies, Accounting, Finance, or equivalent from a university recognized by HEC.
Higher qualifications in the above fields shall be preferred during selection.
Experience Requirements:
Two years’ experience may apply.

jobs.title: PA
jobs.description: Minimum 14 years’ university degree (minimum 2nd Division) from an HEC-recognized university with 100/50 w.p.m. speed in shorthand and typing, respectively. Higher qualifications and computer literacy shall be preferred.

jobs.title: Steno-typist
jobs.description: Minimum 14 years’ university degree (minimum 2nd Division) from an HEC-recognized university with 80/40 w.p.m. speed in shorthand and typing, respectively. Higher qualifications and computer literacy shall be preferred.

jobs.title: Computer Operator
jobs.description: Minimum 14 years’ university degree (minimum 2nd Division) in Computer Science from an HEC-recognized university with Diploma in Information Technology (DIT). Higher qualifications in IT shall be preferred.

jobs.title: Upper Division Clerk
jobs.description: Intermediate (minimum 2nd Division) with 80/40 w.p.m. typing speed. Higher qualifications and computer literacy shall be preferred.

jobs.title: Data Entry Operator
jobs.description: Intermediate (minimum 2nd Division) with speed of 10,000 key depressions per hour on a computer.

jobs.title: Naib Quasid
jobs.description:
File movement – carry files, dak, and official documents within office.
Office upkeep – assist in cleanliness and basic maintenance of office.
Support services – provide tea/water and assist officers/staff when needed.
Delivery work – deliver mail, notices, and small items to sections/departments.
Assistance duties – help in arranging meeting rooms and furniture.
General support – perform routine non-clerical tasks as assigned.
Follow Instructions – carry out duties as directed by supervisors.
Any other duty assigned by his/ her seniors time to time.

jobs.title: Mali
jobs.description:
Garden maintenance – care for lawns, plants, and green areas.
Planting work – plant flowers, trees, and seasonal plants.
Watering & care – regularly water plants and ensure proper growth.
Pruning & trimming – cut overgrown branches and maintain shape of plants.
Cleanliness – remove weeds, dry leaves, and keep garden tidy.
Tool handling – use gardening tools safely and properly.
Nursery support – assist in preparing soil and plant beds.
Any other duty assigned by his/ her seniors time to time.

jobs.title: Sanitary Worker
jobs.description:
Cleaning duties – clean offices, rooms, corridors, and washrooms.
Waste disposal – collect and properly dispose of garbage.
Hygiene maintenance – ensure cleanliness and sanitary conditions in premises.
Washroom upkeep – clean toilets and restock basic hygiene supplies.
Sweeping & mopping – regularly sweep and mop assigned areas.
Infection control – follow basic sanitation and safety practices.
Routine work – perform cleaning tasks as per schedule or instructions.
Any other duty assigned by his/ her seniors time to time.
